meta.name: Scooby Doo! Frankencreepy
meta.description: Velma discovers she's inherited her great-great-uncle's cursed castle in Transylvania, Pennsylvania. The team decide to go there on a spooky adventure.
meta.slogan: Scooby-Doo and those "meddling kids" Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are back in this all-new adventure!
